results.instruction: Park the car on a level surface, such as a flat driveway.
Open the hood and locate the dipstick.
Identify the dipstick by its yellow handle shaped like a crossbar.
Pull the dipstick out and wipe it clean with a rag or paper towel.
Locate the 'add' and 'full' marks on the dipstick.
Slide the dipstick back into its slot, push it all the way down, and pull it out again.
Check the oil level on the stick; if it is at or below the 'add' line, you need to add oil.
Remove the oil fill cap, which is marked with an icon resembling an oil can, and place a funnel into the opening.
Pour a small amount of the recommended oil into the funnel slowly, ensuring it does not go above the 'full' mark.
Pour a quarter of the bottle of oil into the funnel.
Use only the kind of oil recommended by your manual.
Keep rechecking the oil until it's between add and full.
If your oil is consistent on the low side, you may have a leak.
Have your car checked by a professional.
Remove the funnel and replace the oil cap.
Replace the dipstick, making sure it's all the way in.
Close the hood and take her for a spin.
